cases.name: async coroutine inherits thread data (print works)
cases.note: The executable Rust owner test preserves the pinned literal async/await program, including both print calls around the suspension, and asserts the exact two captured console lines through the installed host print callback.

adaptation.inapplicable_observable: The raw C++ ScriptingContext pointer identity installed with lua_setthreaddata on the parent Luau thread and inherited by the resumed coroutine.
adaptation.rationale: mlua does not expose the raw C++ host thread-data pointer contract. The Rust adaptation verifies its runtime-observable equivalent: the same installed host print callback is available before suspension and after coroutine resumption, producing the exact two pinned messages.
